result.label: good
evidence: Created /app/kv-store.proto with KVStore service and GetVal/SetVal RPCs
Generated pb2 and pb2_grpc bindings via grpc_tools.protoc
Implemented Server class extending KVStoreServicer with dict-backed store
SetVal stores request.value under request.key and returns SetValResponse(val=...); GetVal returns stored value or 0
Server runs on port 5328 in background; smoke test shows distinct keys kept separate
All 7/7 verifier tests passed including functionality and handshake tests
result.reason: The patch fully implements the required KV store server: proto file with correct service/RPCs, generated bindings, a real dict-backed Server on port 5328. Behavior is correct and consistent with the task, and all verifier tests pass legitimately without bypassing checks.
